local: سر زد از افق مهر خاوران
پیامت ای امام «استقلال، آزادی» نقش جان ماست
english: Upwards on the horizon rose the Eastern Sun
The light in the eyes of the Believers in Justice
Bahman is the zenith of our faith.
Your message, O Imam, of Sovereignty and Freedom is imprinted on our souls
